title: Which LLM Reasoning Steps Matter? Thought Anchors
one_line_claim: Identifies critical reasoning steps ('thought anchors') that disproportionately influence LLM reasoning trajectories using counterfactual sentence replacement.
method_summary: Black-box method that measures counterfactual importance by replacing each sentence with semantically different alternatives sampled from the model and observing changes to downstream reasoning and final answers. Identifies thought anchors with outsized impact on reasoning trajectories, typically involving planning or uncertainty management.

key_findings.finding: Certain sentences have outsized impact on reasoning trajectories and can be identified through counterfactual replacement.
key_findings.quote: certain sentences can have an outsized impact on the trajectory of the reasoning trace and final answer

key_findings.finding: Critical reasoning steps typically involve planning or uncertainty management, with specialized attention heads consistently directing focus toward these anchors.
key_findings.quote: planning or uncertainty management with specialized attention patterns directing subsequent sentences toward them

key_findings.finding: Sentence-level causal analysis can predict problem difficulty and the extent different question domains involve sequential or diffuse reasoning.
key_findings.quote: predict a problem's difficulty and the extent different question domains involve sequential or diffuse reasoning

relation_to_herald.shared: Both analyze per-token or per-sentence behavior during generation to understand what drives LLM reasoning, both care about identifying critical decision points.
differs_on: This paper studies normal reasoning via interpretability (which sentences matter); HERALD predicts compression-induced catastrophic failures from logit features.
This paper uses counterfactual replacement as the importance mechanism; HERALD uses XGBoost on signal statistics.
This paper operates at sentence granularity in chain-of-thought; HERALD operates at token granularity on logit distributions.
